component.name: EMBEDDING (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)
component.description:
What it does Turns pieces of text into embeddings - lists of numbers that capture what the text means - using OpenAI's embedding models, so a vector database can later find the passages closest in meaning to a question.

How it works Point it at the field holding the list of texts; chunks, the default, is what a text splitter produces. The texts are sent to OpenAI in batches using your organization's OpenAI key, bound as a secret and never written into the template. The vectors come back in the same order as the texts and next to them, and everything else in the incoming data passes through untouched. An empty list is fine and produces no vectors. A missing field, an unbound key or a failed request fails the run - a partial result is never passed on.

Configure
- Embedding Model - text-embedding-3-small (default), text-embedding-3-large or text-embedding-ada-002. Index and search with the same model.
- Texts Field - where the list of texts is in the incoming data; chunks by default. A dotted path such as result.chunks reaches nested data.
- OpenAI API Key - bind the organization secret holding the key.

In and out In: data, or a JSON artifact, carrying a list of texts. Out: the incoming data plus embeddings, texts, embedding_count, embedding_model and dimensions.

Use it when
- Indexing documents into a vector database for search or question answering.
- Embedding a user's question so it can be matched against indexed documents.
- Comparing pieces of text by meaning rather than by wording.
component.short_description: Turns a list of texts into OpenAI embedding vectors, in order, for a vector database to store or search.

component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: agent
name: Embedding
description: >
  Embeds a list of texts with the OpenAI embeddings API, in batches, and
  returns the vectors in input order next to the texts, with every inbound
  field passed through. An empty list yields no vectors; a missing field,
  key or failed request raises and fails the run.

input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    # The texts may arrive as the artifact (a list, a string, or an object
    # carrying Texts Field) or in request_data, so the artifact is optional.
    artifact_type_input: optional(json)
    request_data:
      chunks: array (optional) - Default location of the texts, overridable via the Texts Field parameter.
    artifact_type_output: json
    # Upstream fields are spread into the result (`{**request_data, ...}`).
    response_data_passthrough: request_data
    response_data:
      embeddings: array - Embedding vectors, one per text, in input order.
      texts: array - The texts that were embedded, aligned with embeddings.
      embedding_count: integer - Number of vectors produced.
      embedding_model: string - Embedding model that produced the vectors.
      dimensions: integer - Length of each vector (0 when nothing was embedded).

required_secrets:
- name: openai_api_key
  label: OpenAI API Key
  required: true
  description: OpenAI API key used for the embeddings request.

input_parameters:
- name: model
  type: select
  label: Embedding Model
  options:
  - text-embedding-3-small
  - text-embedding-3-large
  - text-embedding-ada-002
  default: text-embedding-3-small
  required: true
  description: OpenAI embedding model. Use the same model to index documents and to embed questions.
- name: texts_field
  type: text
  label: Texts Field
  default: chunks
  required: true
  description: Field of the incoming data (or JSON artifact) holding the list of texts. A dotted path such as result.chunks reaches nested data.

chunks.description: Default location of the texts, overridable via the Texts Field parameter.

embeddings.description: Embedding vectors, one per text, in input order.

texts.description: The texts that were embedded, aligned with embeddings.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model that produced the vectors.

dimensions.description: Length of each vector (0 when nothing was embedded).
